Name: HxW Fairy Garden Gnome House Building Retextures
Author: Wildflourmods
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/weGWYka.png[/img]﻿

[size=4]For all of our Alternative Textures' fans out there - this one is just for you. Transform your silos, junimo huts and even your obelisks into adorable fairy houses from our [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16874]Fairy Garden Furniture[/url]﻿ Set!

There are 3 files for you to choose from: choose one, choose all, mix and match to your heart's desire!

They all require AT to work; please make sure you have it installed.

[b]Silo Pack [/b]- 18 different textures to choose from!
[b]Junimo Hut Pack[/b] - ANOTHER 18 textures to choose from!

[b]Obelisk Pack[/b] - This pack includes re-textures for the Earth, Water, Island and Desert Obelisks AS WELL AS obelisks from mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Visit Mt Vapius[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url]﻿. It will also have one for Sunberry Village after release <3

Enjoy what Hime does? Support her on [url=https://www.patreon.com/Himetarts]Patreon[/url]﻿ and follow on [url=https://twitter.com/himetarts]Twitter[/url] for previews!

Buy Wildflour a [url=https://ko-fi.com/wildflourmods]Kofi[/url]﻿!

[b]Other Mods in Screenshots That Pair Well with these Sets - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23071]Idaida's Fairy Buildings [/url]﻿and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22501]Flooring[/url]﻿!

[b]Known Issues:[/b]

- The UI for Alternative Textures is a little wonky on junimo huts since within the game files, all of the seasonals are shown in one png. It just LOOKS weird but you should be able to pick different textures just fine. I can let PeacefulEnd know about it but in the meantime it's TOTALLY fine and NOT a bug for you to report. I mean it. Don't report it. Please.

-The recolors in the latest Fairy Garden update MAY make it into this - if we have time.[/size][/center]
